parsed.reason: Description A says concurrent find() calls race on the shared cache dict (pop/reinsert/evict without locking), causing KeyError or lost entries. Description B says find() returns the cached list object itself, so callers that sort it in place corrupt later cached results. Different failures: thread-safety of dict operations versus aliasing of the returned mutable list.
